rows.contract: Qt graphics controls expose supported backend and scope-dependent settings without changing existing public constructors or slots.
rows.native_mapping: Keep public API unchanged. Declare the native-only availability updater and matching per-game CheckState behind ENABLE_METAL.
rows.expected_result: Real MOC, native/off compiler and exact Qt setter behavior with supported, unsupported and absent adapters.
rows.actual_result: Real Qt MOC and application link, native/feature-off compilation, exact reproduced unsupported-device opt-out test repaired, normal and per-game controls, CTest 64 and PICA 48/801.

rows.contract: The active graphics API and device affect the availability of hardware settings.
rows.native_mapping: Retain the current enabled Spatial setting when switching and permit turning it off on unsupported hardware, then prevent enabling it there.
rows.expected_result: With native Spatial enabled, switch to unsupported Spatial adapter, disable Spatial, apply successfully and preserve settings isolation.
rows.actual_result: Real Qt MOC and application link, native/feature-off compilation, exact reproduced unsupported-device opt-out test repaired, normal and per-game controls, CTest 64 and PICA 48/801.
